title: Pals Rewards Earning Schedule — Tailwise Grooming Salon Purchases
content:
**Earning rule.** Tailwise Grooming Salon pass purchases, Groom Club monthly fees and checkout charges earn Pals Rewards points at the member's base earn rate multiplied by the pass's points multiplier; refunds and fees for late cancellation never earn. A customer without an active Pals Rewards membership earns nothing.

**Points multiplier by pass**

| Pass | Multiplier on the member's base earn rate |
|---|---|
| Express Bath Pass 3-Visit | 1 |
| Bath & Tidy Pass 4-Visit | 1 |
| Full Groom Pass 4-Visit | 1 |
| Full Groom Pass 6-Visit | 1 |
| Spa Groom Pass 6-Visit | 2 |
| Groom Club Monthly | 2 |

**What earns and what does not**

| Salon amount | Earns points |
|---|---|
| price paid for a pass | yes |
| Groom Club Monthly monthly fee | yes |
| amount charged at checkout of a visit | yes |
| refund | never |
| fee for a late cancellation | never |
| any amount, customer without an active Pals Rewards membership | nothing is earned |

**Illustration (hypothetical purchases by an active Pals Rewards member)** — a Spa Groom Pass 6-Visit bought for 469.20 earns at twice the member's base earn rate; a Full Groom Pass 6-Visit bought for 357.00 earns at the base earn rate itself.
